caption: “Monotropa uniflora. Indian pipe.” John Torrey. A Flora of the State of New-York. Volume 1. Albany, New York: Carroll and Cook, 1843.
alt: A hand-coloured botanical plate of Indian pipe: three pale, scaly white stems rising from a small brown root ball, two curling over into nodding flowers and one upright, with five numbered details of the flower parts and seed capsule below.
